name: SFTP Consumer
helpText:
SFTP Consumer

This consumer is variation of Scheduled Consumer which is a "time event" based consumer configured to be either an absolute or relative time schedule, backed by (S)FTP Message provider.
allowableProperties_comment: Note that the order of properties in this file dictates the order displayed on screen, unless propertyDisplayOrder is set, which will be used as the primary key

componentName.helpText: The name of the component as displayed on diagrams. The name should be unique for the flow. The name will be used internally to reflect the bean created.

ageOfFiles.helpText: How many days to keep meta data relating to files already processedn (used to prevent processing the same file twice), the default is -1 means for ever.

checksum.helpText: Default(False) Flag indicating whether to verify integrity of retrieved file by comparing with a checksum supplied by the remote system.

chronological.helpText: If true, when multiple files are available, process the oldest first. Default is false which means order of processing is non-deterministic.

chunkSize.helpText: Size of chunks to use (when chunking=true). Default(1048576) 1MB.

chunking.helpText: If true, file download should be performed in smaller distinguished data chunks of size defined by chunkSize configuration. Default is false.

cleanupJournalOnComplete.helpText: Only set to false when debugging. When true (default) the journal information is deleted whe the file is processed successfully. The journal is a durable log of in-progress FTP operations, letting the connector detect and safely replay/resolve transactions interrupted by a crash — instead of losing or duplicating file processing.

clientID.helpText: ClientID is used in the persisted meta data to identify this component uniquely in the context of the module. Since a flow can only have 1 consumer, the flow name makes for a good, default, client ID.

configuration.helpText: Provide the classname of a class that extends SftpConsumerConfiguration, encapsulating all the properties here into a single bean. Useful for binding config via Spring @ConfigurationProperties, or extending with fields the builder doesn't expose (e.g. a failover host, see FtpConsumerAlternateConfiguration for the equivalent FTP pattern). Using it will reduce your ability to configure the component within this tool.
configuration.validationMessage: Provide a java classname for the Configuration bean.

configurationId.helpText: By default, the configuration ID = modulename + flowname + componentName + componentType. There are times when you may wish to override this i.e. if you want multiple flows to share the same configration or you have changed a flow name but don't want to update properties that may have already been stored in the override properties database.

connectionTimeout.helpText: Internal (S)FTP connector connection timeout value in milliseconds. Default is 60000 (1 minute).

criticalOnStartup.helpText: Default(False). Identify this component as being critical for starting the flow i.e. if the component fails to start, the whole flow will not start.

cronExpression.helpText: Cron based expression dictating the invocation schedule for this component. Example, '*/5 * * * * ?' will fire every 5 seconds.

dataTimeout.helpText: Internal FTP connector data connection timeout value in milliseconds. Default is 300000 (5 minutes).

destructive.helpText: Delete file after successful consumption. Default is false.

eager.helpText: When true (default is false), attempt to process all available files. MaxEagerCallbacks can be used to limit the number of files before reverting to business schedule.

eventFactory.helpText: Provide the classname that overrides and implements the default EventFactory interface. The Event factory used to instantiate ikasan flow events based on incoming payload from the tech endpoint. Pre-built implementations you can wire in instead of writing your own: org.ikasan.spec.flow.FlowEventFactory (Ikasan's built-in default, used automatically unless overridden).
eventFactory.validationMessage: Provide a java classname for the Configuration bean.

filenamePattern.helpText: Regular expression for matching file names to be transported.

ignoreMisfire.helpText: Default(True). If true, ignore Quartz misfires (a missed scheduled cron fire time, e.g. due to scheduler downtime) and simply wait for the next scheduled time; if false, Quartz will fire the job once immediately to catch up on the missed run.

isRecursive.helpText: Default(False) Works together with sourceDirectory and filenamePattern: if true, recurse into subdirectories of sourceDirectory (unlimited depth), and filenamePattern is applied to files found there too, not just files directly in sourceDirectory. Useful when consuming from a top-level directory without knowing its full subdirectory structure.

knownHostFilename.helpText: The location of the known hosts file.

managedEventIdentifierService.helpText: Optional, and safe to leave unset for most flows. Ikasan gives every message a tracking ID as it processes it - used to correlate a message in the audit trail/dashboard, and to recognise the same message again if a flow error 'parks' it for later retry. By default this ID is just a raw hash of the file's content (functional, but not human-readable). Setting this property lets you supply your own class to derive a more meaningful ID instead - for file consumers, a common choice is org.ikasan.component.endpoint.filetransfer.ManagedEventFileTransferIdentifierService, which uses the filename, making it much easier to recognise in the dashboard.
managedEventIdentifierService.validationMessage: Provide a java classname for the consumer event provider bean.

maxEagerCallbacks.helpText: The maximum number of consecutive eager scheduled callbacks (when eager is set to true) before reverting to business schedule. Default is unlimited until no more data available.

maxRows.helpText: When housekeeping the meta data, i.e. ageOfFiles has been exceeded, this will set the batch size for deletion. Default (-1) means unlimited.

messageProvider.helpText: Provide the classname that overrides and implements the default MessageProvider interface. The message provider is responsible for providing the message payload. Pre-built implementations you can wire in instead of writing your own: org.ikasan.component.endpoint.quartz.consumer.QuartzMessageProvider, org.ikasan.component.endpoint.quartz.consumer.CallBackMessageProvider, org.ikasan.component.endpoint.filesystem.messageprovider.FileMessageProvider, org.ikasan.component.endpoint.filesystem.messageprovider.CorrelatingFileMessageProvider, org.ikasan.component.endpoint.db.messageprovider.DbMessageProvider, org.ikasan.endpoint.sftp.consumer.SftpMessageProvider, org.ikasan.endpoint.ftp.consumer.FtpMessageProvider.
messageProvider.validationMessage: Provide a java classname for the Message Provider bean.

minAge.helpText: The minimum age of the file on the remote filesystem before file can be processed. This setting is in place to prevent (S)FTP consumer from picking up file which is still being written to. The default is 120 seconds.

moveOnSuccessNewPath.helpText: Optional only applicable when moveOnSuccess is set to true, it provides new directory path for the processed file to be moved to.

password.helpText: Password used to login to (S)FTP server where consumer needs to connect. Takes precedences over privateKeyFilename. If both provided user/password combination will be used to login rather then user/privateKeyFilename.

remoteHost.helpText: Default('localhost') host name of the remote SFTP server where consumer needs to connect.

remotePort.helpText: Default(22) port of the remote SFTP server where consumer needs to connect.

renameOnSuccess.helpText: Default(False) Flag indicating whether to rename the processed file after successful consumption.

renameOnSuccessExtension.helpText: Required renameOnSuccess set to true (in which case this MUST be set). This is the extension appended to the file on the remote system after successful processing, e.g. '.processed'. May include an embedded timestamp using /[dateFormat]/, e.g. '/yyyyMMddHHmmss/.complete'.

sourceDirectory.helpText: Remote directory from which to discover files.

sourceDirectoryURLFactory.helpText: Provide the classname that overrides and implements the DirectoryURLFactory interface. The factory provides more flexible way of defining source directory. Most common use case would be when source directory changes names for instancebased on date.
sourceDirectoryURLFactory.validationMessage: Provide a java classname for the Source Directory URL Factory bean.

timezone.helpText: Optional. The timezone the cronExpression schedule is evaluated in, e.g. 'America/New_York' or 'Europe/London'. If left unset, the JVM's own default timezone is used — only set this if the schedule needs to run consistently in a specific timezone regardless of where the module is deployed.

transactionManager.helpText: Provide the classname that overrides and implements the default JtaTransactionManager interface. Typically this is the Spring transaction manager, overriding may be needed to interface into third party containers.
transactionManager.validationMessage: Provide a java classname for the transaction manager bean.

username.helpText: User name used to login to SFTP server where consumer needs to connect.
